notes.title: Open Beta Playtest
notes.content:
[b]Morgenstern’s Open Beta is now available![/b] Since the demo, we’ve made huge progress, adding exciting new content, mechanics, and improvements. Development has been moving fast, and we can’t wait for you to experience everything the game has to offer. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627210/Morgenstern/

Of course, there’s still more work to be done, and we’re counting on[b] your feedback[/b] to help shape Morgenstern’s future. By launching the Open Beta now, we want to ensure we have enough time to listen, refine, and implement your suggestions before the full release.  

Join the Morgenstern community today! Dive into the Beta, share your thoughts, and connect with fellow players on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Q4pg7rZnRk] Discord server [/url]. Your input will play a crucial role in making Morgenstern the best it can be.

Morgenstern is a third-person rogue-like hack-and-slash that fuses the infernal runs of Hades with Vampire Survivors’ addictive progression, delivering relentless solo and multiplayer chaos in a destructible medieval nightmare. It blends co-op extraction with rogue-like depth and absurd humor to hook fans of intense action and wild replayability.

What to Expect:

[list]
[*]Suit Up: Choose your class and forge a custom loadout for brutal efficiency.
[*]Squad or Solo: Tackle the carnage alone or with friends in seamless online co-op.
[*]Slay the Insane: Face off against the deranged Uber Knight Torreto, hordes of medieval Karens, [*]anda rogue’s gallery of unhinged foes.
[*]Arm Yourself: Wield devastating weapons and spells to shred enemy waves.
[*]Grow Stronger: Earn permanent upgrades to dominate with every descent.
[*]Raid the Depths: Risk it all in dungeons for epic loot—or extract with your haul.
[*]Hold the Line: Escape the fray to secure gear and XP for the next run.
[*]Smash It All: Unleash havoc on fully destructible battlegrounds.
[*]Bacon Backup: Die in co-op? Respawn as a pig—revive if your team triumphs!
[/list]

notes.title: Morgenstern Demo
notes.content:
Get a first look into the world of [b]Morgenstern[/b] and download the single- and multiplayer demo today

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3228400/

[b]What to expect:[/b]

•  [u]Gear Up:[/u] Choose from 5 unique classes and equip yourself with a personalized loadout.

•  [u]Team up:[/u] Play solo or team up with your friends in online coop

•  [u]Battle fierce enemies:[/u] Face off against the mad uber knight Torreto and waves of crazy medieval Karens.

•  [u]Weapons and Spells:[/u] Utilize a variety of spells and weapons to slay hordes of enemies.

• [u] Face the Ultimate Challenge:[/u] Enter the dungeon for epic rewards, or...

•  [u]Secure your progress:[/u] Extract from the battle arena to keep your gear and XP.

•  [u]Destroy Everything:[/u]  Unleash your anger on destructible environments.

•  [u]Playing with friends? :[/u] No worries if you die! You'll respawn as a pig, and if your friend beats the current wave, you'll be resurrected.

[previewyoutube=xKmwTeb2Gi0;full][/previewyoutube]
Have fun, and feel free to leave some feedback on this early demo. Your input will help make the game even better till release
